messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Observability alert — traces & logs missing for tenant corpA in vpc-prod-pool-12. Indexing pipeline returning 404 for tenant path. Started ~1769876400. Pager: @elaine. https://intranet.redwood/incident/INC-2026-045 :rotating_light:

elaine: taking this — oncall SRE. Quick question: is this just traces or also runtime logs/metrics?

corpA-ops: we see our app traces disappear in tracing UI and our support team can't fetch logs via the portal. Errors say "tenant not found". This started around 15:20 UTC.

raj: seen similar alert. Looks like the tenant-routing key for corpA got dropped from the dedicated-pool routing table after the config rollout at 15:05. I can confirm indexer still has messages for other tenants.

mia: tagging runtime eng — if routing key removed, traces get dropped upstream at the log-router before being written to tenant index. Need to know if this is due to config-service rollback or a control-plane write failure.

elaine: runbook step 1: check routing table state and routing-service logs. raj, can you check `routing-service` config at 15:05 and grep for corpA?

raj: on it. quick grep:
```
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/routing-service | grep "corpA" -B3 -A3 | tail -n 40
```
Output shows a 500 from config-service when attempting to persist tenant route at 15:06. Also see these entries: `RouteRemoved(tenant=corpA, reason=policy_validation)`

sam: looped in corpA success rep — letting them know we're investigating. corpA is on Dedicated (reserved) pool, high-impact customer.

corpA-ops: thanks. This is affecting tracing and also our debug logs for a live incident on our side. We need a temporary extraction path to pull logs for the last hour.

elaine: understood. Immediate mitigation options: 1) re-add routing key for corpA to routing-service (fast, requires config write), 2) enable proxy-forwarding from dedicated-pool to central-log-collector (safer, read-only), 3) provide corpA with host-level capture tarball (manual). I'm leaning 1 then 2 as fallback.

raj: re-adding is blocked if config-service write fails. I'm seeing `config-service` 500s tied to DB migration quorum spike. Team is rolling back migration now. ETA 7–10m.

mia: can we do proxy-forwarding (option 2) without config write? There's an emergency path: enable `rescue-proxy` via /ops/controls which toggles an env var on the dedicated-pool routers. I can flip it but need approval — it will temporarily bypass tenant isolation for routing (read-only forwarding), audited.

elaine: do it. Post the exact command you run. Need audit trail. Please confirm scope only corpA.

mia: executing now. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood/internal/rescue-proxy \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"pool":"vpc-prod-pool-12","tenant":"corpA","mode":"forward-only"}'
```
Waiting for confirmation...

incident-bot: Rescue proxy toggled for corpA in vpc-prod-pool-12 by mia. Forward-only mode active.

sam: corpA-ops, can you confirm if you see traces/logs reappearing in the portal?

corpA-ops: partial traces are coming back in the tracing UI, zips of span payloads showing up. Logs still intermittent but improving. Thank you.

elaine: good. Now we need long-term fix: root cause seems to be config-service migration failure causing route removal. raj to lead rollback/patch. Mia to validate audit and ensure forward-only proxy doesn't expose write paths. Sam to keep customer updated and capture impact window for credits.

raj: starting rollback of DB migration now. I'll monitor for any additional `RouteRemoved` events. If rollback succeeds I'll reapply the route via safe write.

mia: validating audit scope — rescue-proxy only opens read-forwarding, confirmed no write tokens leaked. Audit entry: `ops-api:rescue-proxy toggle by mia at 1769876805 for corpA`

elaine: handoff note — I'm pausing primary oncall here. If rollback completes and route is re-added, close incident. If not, pager-duty escalate to infra pager after 30m. @pager-duty set timer 30m.

pager-duty: Timer set: 30 minutes. Next escalation to infra-pager if unresolved.

raj: rollback succeeded at 1769876880. Re-applying route now with safe-write:
```
POST /config-service/routes
{"tenant":"corpA","pool":"vpc-prod-pool-12","policy":"dedicated"}
```
Response: 200 OK. RouteAdded event emitted.

incident-bot: RouteAdded(tenant=corpA) detected. Observability ingestion should resume. Please verify.

sam: corpA-ops, can you verify final state and whether any logs/traces are still missing? We will compile missing time ranges and provide a retrieval path.

corpA-ops: tracing looks backfilled to 16:26 UTC, logs for 15:20–15:32 are missing but we can pull host-level capture for that window if needed. Appreciate the fast response.

elaine: good job team. Post-incident actions: 1) infra to add guard in config-service to prevent migration from deleting active routes, 2) obs team to add metrics/alert for `RouteRemoved` >0 in dedicated pools, 3) runbook update to include rescue-proxy steps and approval audit. Sam will coordinate customer comms and credits.

sam: I'll draft the customer report and timeline. Will DM corpA-ops and confirm retrieval of missing logs.

elaine: closing oncall handoff — leaving detailed notes in the incident doc. If anything reappears, re-open thread. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
